"import csv
from docx import Document

CSV_FILE = "perf_04.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "report.docx"


def read_csv_rows(path):
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        rows = [r for r in reader if r]
    return rows


def fmt_num(v, ndigits):
    return f"{float(v):.{ndigits}f}"


def main():
    rows = read_csv_rows(CSV_FILE)
    n = len(rows)

    cl_max_vals = [float(r["cl_max"]) for r in rows]
    cd_cruise_vals = [float(r["cd_cruise"]) for r in rows]
    ld_vals = [float(r["ld_ratio"]) for r in rows]

    cl_max_max = max(cl_max_vals)
    cd_cruise_mean = sum(cd_cruise_vals) / len(cd_cruise_vals)
    ld_mean = sum(ld_vals) / len(ld_vals)
    best_idx = ld_vals.index(max(ld_vals))
    best_config = rows[best_idx]["config"]

    doc = Document()

    doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report — Performance Sweep 04", level=0)

    doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"This report summarizes the performance test data contained in "
        f"perf_04.csv. The dataset comprises {n} data records (excluding "
        f"the header row). Key aerodynamic metrics — maximum lift "
        f"coefficient (CLmax), cruise drag coefficient (CDcruise), and the "
        f"lift-to-drag ratio (L/D) — are reported for each configuration."
    )

    doc.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1 + n, cols=4)
    table.style = "Table Grid"

    headers = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        table.rows[0].cells[i].text = h

    for r_idx, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        cells = table.rows[r_idx].cells
        cells[0].text = row["config"]
        cells[1].text = fmt_num(row["cl_max"], 3)
        cells[2].text = fmt_num(row["cd_cruise"], 4)
        cells[3].text = fmt_num(row["ld_ratio"], 1)

    doc.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
    summary_para = doc.add_paragraph()
    summary_para.add_run(
        f"Across the {n} configurations tested, the maximum lift coefficient "
        f"reached CLmax max = {cl_max_max:.3f}. The average cruise drag "
        f"coefficient was CDcruise mean = {cd_cruise_mean:.4f}, while the "
        f"mean lift-to-drag ratio was L/D mean = {ld_mean:.1f}. The "
        f"configuration that delivered the highest aerodynamic efficiency "
        f"(maximum L/D) was {best_config}."
    )

    doc.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"The performance sweep indicates that configuration {best_config} "
        f"offers the most favorable trade-off between lift generation and "
        f"cruise drag, achieving the highest L/D ratio in the dataset. The "
        f"average L/D of {ld_mean:.1f} and the peak CLmax of {cl_max_max:.3f} "
        f"provide useful benchmarks for downstream design refinement. "
        f"No single configuration dominates across all metrics, so further "
        f"trade studies are recommended to balance lift capability against "
        f"drag penalty for the intended mission profile."
    )

    doc.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT_FILE} with {n} data rows.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
